A22.title: ABI/API Upgrades and Compatibility Testing
A22.boundary_and_ownership: Upstream/package/ABI/behavior compatibility and patch upgrade verification.
A22.native_reuse: Actual upstream API/source maps, Cargo.lock/checksums and package/provenance tooling.
A22.csharp_surface: Maintainer compatibility manifest and version-matrix runner; no runtime auto-update service.
implementation_steps: Compare old/new public/private seams, layout/capability/schema/semantic versions, selected features/MSRV and dependency/license changes.
Run old managed/new native and new managed/old native compatibility plus incompatible major/feature negatives.
Bind fork patch queue to exact upstream and differential tests with exit owner; prefer public replacement when available.
Record security cooldown exceptions and rollback immutable package set; baseline performance method from D13.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: A source tag or package version alone cannot prove compiled artifact identity.
Same ABI bytes with changed SQL/error/cancel semantics still requires compatibility decision.
specific_acceptance: Deliberately incompatible layout/capability/semantic changes fail, compatible optional minor passes on both OS.
Manifest/provenance substitution, stale artifact and changed private seam negatives; reviewed update/rollback record.

Verify compatible/incompatible exact package-closure evolution, permitted author/repository signature identity and payload/nuspec/native verification, same-version conflict handling, unlist behavior and rollback to the previous complete closure. Never disable signature or identity checks to make a retry succeed.
A22.dependency_rationale: start pins only actually consumed completed modules; acceptance adds local assembled-runtime checks where required. Reference links alone never become a global barrier.

A24.title: Engine Integration Scaffolding and Conformance Entry Points
A24.boundary_and_ownership: Small Engine manifest/scaffold and repeatable conformance entrypoint, no fourth planning system.
A24.native_reuse: Reuse A09–A13 generation/build infrastructure and mature Engine-specific seam selection.
A24.csharp_surface: CLI/templates produce maintainer adapter package and typed static facade skeleton with clear ownership.
implementation_steps: Generate only opted-in ABI/ownership/error/buffer/async/affinity pieces from a minimal Engine descriptor.
Include exact upstream/crate/patch/features/target provenance and source/test coverage obligations.
Run scaffold through A17 synchronous and A18 async profiles and show unchanged Core modules where no new common capability is needed.
Keep product application variation as metadata/managed methods; scaffolding is a maintainer action, never hidden consumer compilation.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Unknown required capability/layout or missing owner release fails scaffold validation.
Do not export private source layout or automatically create a global executor.
specific_acceptance: Two heterogeneous real Engine scaffolds compile and pass respective conformance; generated imports/export inventory matches.
Independent package consumption and deliberate unsupported schema/feature negative; exact template source/hash.

worktree_policy: One branch/worktree per task, exact owned scopes; root solution/Cargo workspace registration is an A13 integration patch under the small workspace-manifest lock. No global worker lock.
phase_authorization: No product writes or A/B execution authorized in this research/design turn.
evolution_rules: Four independent identities: source/crate, C ABI, C# API and domain semantics; record relation rather than merge versions.
Any changed accepted input invalidates dependent review by exact hash/revision snapshot; re-review affected slice, not every unrelated task.
Controlled fork requires upstream base/patch queue/license/security owner/exit condition and direct-native regression oracles.
New Engine uses existing schema/contracts and a scoped task/fragment amendment in the existing three graphs, no fourth workflow.
No automatic production dependency promotion; security exception records reason and exact update evidence.
